End the week with the strongest cliffhangers to push viewers into binge‑watching the series.

concerns.issue: Weak ending signal may hint at later plot resolution.
Weak ending signal could reveal too much about the mysterious antagonist.
Spoiler risk 2 – reveals secret‑identity rumor, placed later to mitigate impact.

promos.title: Episode12_DeadlyUltimatum
promos.hook: I want to see you crawl, sister.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa, her expression hardening as the scene freezes.
promos.why: A chilling challenge and a defiant heroine set up a high‑stakes test that begs the audience to stay for the brutal outcome.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: I want to see you crawl, sister.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I am not letting them take you.
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Tell me where the garden is.
Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

promos.post_reason: Powerful family‑cruelty cliffhanger (ep12) serves as the week’s climax to drive binge.

promos.title: Garden Assault
promos.hook: Juliana: “Stop! What are you doing?!”
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander storms forward, eyes blazing, as the thugs close in.
promos.why: A sudden violent intrusion into Juliana’s sacred garden, capped by Alexander’s fierce arrival, creates immediate tension and a fight‑or‑flight question.

script.text: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Stop! What are you doing?!

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: We're clearing this rubbish.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Those are medicinal plants!

script.speaker: BALD THUG
script.text: They look like weeds to me.
The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!

script.speaker: TALL THUG
script.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Leave my garden alone.

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: Get out of the way!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No.
The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Ah!
Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My mother's plants...

script.speaker: BALD THUG
script.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!
The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Stop!
Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.

promos.post_reason: Mid‑season high‑stakes assault (ep15) ramps tension without major spoilers.

promos.title: Ep16 – Heroic Catch & Betrayal Reveal
promos.hook: Alexander catches the weapon mid‑air with chilling ease.
promos.cliffhanger: “Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!” – the confession that the fiancé is behind the attack.
promos.why: Shows the hero’s unstoppable skill, then drops a gut‑punch betrayal that makes any viewer want to know what happens next.

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: Aaargh!
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.

script.speaker: BALD THUG
script.text: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.

script.speaker: THIRD THUG
script.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Are you hurt?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Only my hands.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who sent you?

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: No one!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who?!

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Gerald...

promos.title: Ep2_Rejection_Humiliation
promos.hook: Former Groom (Cold, Callous): "I cannot marry you, Juliana."
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana (Whispering, Crushed): "You won't even look at me."
promos.why: A brutal rejection opens the clip, and Juliana’s whispered plea ends on a heartbreaking question, making the viewer crave her next move.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.
Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: You are far too plain...

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: ...far too silent...

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Gerald... Look at me.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You gave me your word before both our families.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Father...

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Do not disgrace us further.

promos.post_reason: Early episode (2) introduces Juliana’s core conflict and hooks cold viewers with personal stakes.

promos.title: Toby's Burning Fever
promos.hook: Prudence screams, “Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!”
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana gasps, “His skin is burning hot.”
promos.why: A desperate child’s life hangs in the balance, and the sudden discovery of a mysterious fever hooks viewers instantly.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: We have no clinic now.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!
Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.
Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: His skin is burning hot.

promos.title: Duke_Ep5_Ledger
promos.hook: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "Barbara, don't!"
promos.cliffhanger: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Lethally Cold): "Choose your next words carefully."
promos.why: A visceral scream over a destroyed heirloom followed by a chilling warning creates immediate tension and leaves the outcome unknown.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Barbara, don't!
A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.
Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Here you go.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: They destroyed it.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: They dirtied it. That is not the same thing.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It was my mother's.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Then keep it.
The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Let them keep everything else.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Look at you.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Choose your next words carefully.

promos.post_reason: Early humiliation trope (ep5) brings a mysterious antagonist, deepening intrigue.

promos.title: 22-Guard Threat
promos.hook: Housekeeper (Menacing, Threatening): "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
promos.cliffhanger: Lady Juliana (Shocked, Murmuring): "This isn't ordinary fever."
promos.why: A maid is instantly menaced, then the mystery of a dying Duchess erupts, pulling viewers into the danger and intrigue.

script.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
script.text: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Yes, ma'am.

script.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
script.text: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: That was close.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Where is the West Wing?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: This house...
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Do not stare. Keep walking.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Your Grace?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Do not speak.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: This isn't ordinary fever.

promos.title: Power Threat
promos.hook: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.
promos.cliffhanger: Gerald turns and flees as the scarred bearded husband looms, leaving his threat unanswered.
promos.why: Shows Gerald’s arrogance and the sudden, mysterious power of Juliana’s husband, instantly pulling viewers into the conflict.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: And your husband?

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Where is that beggar husband?
The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.

script.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
script.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: We are leaving.

promos.post_reason: Short, punchy revenge threat (ep7) diversifies tropes and maintains high energy.

promos.title: Episode11_AccusationStorm
promos.hook: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
promos.cliffhanger: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
promos.why: Immediate conflict and a desperate plea that forces viewers to wonder if the family’s secrets will be exposed.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: What? When?

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: The last time I came here.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You never even entered the cottage!

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander would never steal from you.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Choose your next words carefully.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!

script.speaker: CONSTABLE
script.text: I have received a complaint of theft.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: A complaint is not proof.

script.speaker: CONSTABLE
script.text: Then a search will settle the matter.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: If he has nothing to hide...

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: ...let the constable search.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Search it.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Let them.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.

promos.post_reason: Betrayal accusation (ep11) adds family drama and a fresh hook before the finale.

promos.title: Rumor Whisper
promos.hook: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
promos.cliffhanger: The Blond Nobleman whispers, “Impossible,” as a dangerous rumor about Juliana’s husband surfaces.
promos.why: A stark warning turns into a chilling secret that could endanger the protagonists, perfect for a hook‑and‑mystery promo.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then we will face it together.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: What is it?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: What rumor?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Where?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: No one seems certain.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Then let it remain a rumor.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Impossible.

promos.post_reason: Secret‑identity rumor (ep9) caps the week with intrigue, encouraging deeper engagement.

promos.title: Ep3_Rescue_Standstill
promos.hook: Bearded Stranger (Low, Thunderous, Imposing): "Take your hands off her."
promos.cliffhanger: Matriarch (Furious, Hysterical): "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
promos.why: The stranger’s sudden command creates instant tension, and the matriarch’s furious denial leaves the showdown hanging, urging viewers to see what happens next.

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: Take your hands off her.

script.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
script.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: Stand aside, stranger!

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: I said...

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: ...let her go.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: Are you hurt?
Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

script.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
script.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: I can...

promos.post_reason: Shows a rescue scene (ep3) to add action and keep momentum while still early in the story.

promos.title: Episode10_TrustAndTouch
promos.hook: You are a terrible liar.
promos.cliffhanger: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.
promos.why: Shows the fragile intimacy and hidden wounds, pulling viewers into the characters’ secret longing.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You are a terrible liar.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Why do you look at me like that?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Because you are looking at me.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Hold still.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I am holding still.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Perhaps it is your hand.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.

promos.title: Ep38_BellsOfDoom
promos.hook: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
promos.cliffhanger: A sharp, high‑tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.
promos.why: The sudden visual shock paired with the ominous bells instantly conveys danger and urgency, then cuts on a tense musical sting that begs the viewer to see what happens next.

script.text: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Bells.
Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: The wedding.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It's beginning.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then I suppose I'm next.
Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...
A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

promos.title: EP31_Enough_Iron
promos.hook: CATHERINE (Enraged Scream): "Enough!"
promos.cliffhanger: The glowing tip of the branding iron hovers just millimeters from Juliana’s eye, poised to scorch.
promos.why: A raw scream thrusts viewers into the brutal cat‑and‑mouse, ending on a life‑or‑death moment they must see resolved.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Enough!
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: [gasping] Give it back!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: There. Finally. Something still hurts you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

promos.title: EP32_Silence_Iron
promos.hook: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming): "Silence! Silence!"
promos.cliffhanger: Catherine lifts the searing branding rod, the iron tip stopping inches from Juliana’s eye.
promos.why: The frantic scream signals a breaking point, and the near‑burn creates an immediate, unanswered danger.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Silence! Silence!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Why?!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Because I am right!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You want everyone to fear you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But look at you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You insolent—!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You think you can lecture me?!
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

promos.title: Pact Threat
promos.hook: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?
promos.cliffhanger: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.
promos.why: A high‑stakes threat and a secret pact hook viewers instantly, then cut before the pact is sealed, leaving the danger hanging.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.
Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet.

promos.title: Ring of Hope
promos.hook: I found it.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander warns, “You could have lost your hands.”
promos.why: The discovery of the emerald ring promises freedom, then a sudden threat leaves the audience wondering if the price will be paid.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I found it.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Now release my husband.
The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana.
Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: What have they done to you?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Nothing they didn't promise.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Take me home.
Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You should never have had to bleed for me.
Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You could have lost your hands.

promos.title: 44_CatherineGasp
promos.hook: You have no authority!
promos.cliffhanger: Catherine gasps “Her?!” as Alexander walks away toward his chained bride, leaving their love triangle on a knife‑edge.
promos.why: A powerful power‑play line followed by a heartbreaking rejection creates instant tension that hooks a cold viewer.

script.speaker: LORD STERLING
script.text: You have no authority!

script.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
script.text: I have more than enough.
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Do something!
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Do you know what this did to me?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I mourned you.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I waited for you.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I never stopped loving you.
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You don't remember?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You were never my Duchess.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: But I loved you!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: No!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I loved you before all this!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Did you?
Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

promos.title: Ep18 – Fire, Ledger & Last‑Second Rescue
promos.hook: “Alexander!” – Juliana’s desperate scream as the cottage erupts in flames.
promos.cliffhanger: “Leave it!” – Alexander shouts as Juliana clutches her mother’s ledger, refusing to let go.
promos.why: The immediate danger of fire, a frantic rescue, and the unresolved choice over the priceless ledger hook any viewer instantly.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander!
Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...
A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana! Get up!
Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: What happened?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Fire.
Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Stay close to me.
Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: We cannot get through!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then we go another way.
Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: The ledger!
Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Leave it!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No! No!

promos.title: E30_WitchcraftScheme
promos.hook: Then make certain she isn’t! A peasant weed, Rupert!
promos.cliffhanger: Catherine’s cold smile follows the Elder Nobleman’s words, “Witchcraft is a capital charge,” leaving Juliana’s fate hanging.
promos.why: The violent thrust and the ruthless declaration of a capital charge create immediate tension and a clear, high‑stakes conflict.

script.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: What are you suggesting?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You have a solution?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We use the law to destroy her.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: The law?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Then call it witchcraft.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.

promos.title: Catherine's Public Humiliation
promos.hook: Not as a bride this time.
promos.cliffhanger: Ear‑splitting detonation shatters the cathedral, fireball bursts inward.
promos.why: A cruel taunt is followed instantly by a massive explosion, creating an immediate, high‑stakes hook that a new viewer can’t ignore.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Not as a bride this time.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Still arrogant. Still standing.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Come.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Nothing.

script.speaker: PRIEST
script.text: Shall we?
Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.

promos.title: Ep17 – Promise & Uncertain Future
promos.hook: “I would do it again.” – Alexander’s fierce vow to protect Juliana.
promos.cliffhanger: “Not yet.” – Alexander’s cryptic answer as Juliana waits, leaving their fate hanging.
promos.why: A bold promise followed by a tantalizing “not yet” creates emotional tension that pulls viewers into the couple’s fragile safety.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: ...no one will hurt you again.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You cannot promise that.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I just did.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Not yet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then I will wait.
Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I know almost nothing about the man I married.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him.

promos.title: Duke_Ep4_Reject
promos.hook: Gerald (Furious, Shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
promos.cliffhanger: Mysterious Bearded Man (Soft, Protective): "Come, Lady Juliana."
promos.why: Shows the shocking betrayal and the promise of a new path, pulling viewers into Juliana's fight against her family.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: You have thrown yourself away!

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: For a penniless nobody!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I would rather choose my own life...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.
Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.

script.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
script.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!

script.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
script.text: You are disowned!

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Come, Lady Juliana.

promos.title: E29_CellThreat
promos.hook: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope…
promos.cliffhanger: The iron cell door slams shut with a deafening thud, leaving Juliana trapped in darkness.
promos.why: A chilling threat followed by the visceral sound of the cell door instantly puts the viewer in Juliana’s desperate fight for survival.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You were cast out once.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You should have stayed forgotten.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My husband will find me.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Your scarred soldier?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?

script.speaker: GUARD
script.text: Move along, girl.
The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Please!
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.

promos.title: Ep1_Betrayal_Accusation
promos.hook: Matriarch (Cold, Commanding): "You should turn around, Juliana."
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana (Outraged, Accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
promos.why: The matriarch’s cold command instantly shocks the viewer, then Juliana’s furious accusation leaves the betrayal unresolved, pulling the audience in.

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Why?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: Not anymore.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: What do you mean?

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: Look for yourself.
Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Gerald?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Why are you holding her hand?

script.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
script.text: Because he is marrying me.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: No...

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

promos.title: 24-Whip Crack
promos.hook: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
promos.cliffhanger: Lady Juliana (V.O., Steely, Unstoppable): "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."
promos.why: A brutal whipping instantly grabs attention, then Juliana’s defiant promise leaves viewers desperate to see how she’ll fight back.

script.text: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: You are a maid.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Yes, my lady.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Clean it.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: All of it, my lady?

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: My lady—
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Do you want the same punishment?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: No, my lady.
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: That is where clever little servants belong.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I will return. You cannot stop the healer.

promos.title: Alexander's Return
promos.hook: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
promos.cliffhanger: And now, Rupert… we settle what you stole.
promos.why: A bold accusation from the presumed dead Alexander sets up a showdown, ending on a menacing promise that begs for the next episode.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

promos.title: EP33_Desperate_Threat
promos.hook: MAID (Crying, Shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"
promos.cliffhanger: LORD (Relentless): "You saw her use a forbidden book." – the maid’s fate hangs on a forced confession.
promos.why: A terrified plea instantly hooks the audience, and the looming accusation leaves the outcome unknown.

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: What do you want me to say?!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: The truth.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Around him.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Like a circle?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: And she opened her mother's book...

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: She was praying!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Praying... or chanting?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: I don't know!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.

promos.title: Silenced Defiance
promos.hook: "Silence!" – the judge’s furious shout as he slams the gavel.
promos.cliffhanger: "You will speak when addressed!" – the judge’s menacing threat leaves Juliana’s fate hanging.
promos.why: Shows Juliana’s fierce stand against a brutal trial, ending on a threatening command that begs the viewer to see if she will break.

script.text: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: Silence!
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Yes, Your Honor.

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Tell the truth.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: What did you see?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: Did she draw strange markings?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

script.speaker: JUDGE
script.text: You will speak when addressed!

promos.title: 23-Poison Reveal
promos.hook: Lady Juliana (Cold, Deadly Serious): "Someone is poisoning her."
promos.cliffhanger: Prudence (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper): "Juliana... someone is coming."
promos.why: The shocking accusation of murder followed by the sound of an intruder creates immediate tension and a question of who’s behind the poison.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Someone is poisoning her.
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Poison?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Arsenic.
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Can you save her?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I can try.
Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly.
Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Juliana... someone is coming.
Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

promos.title: Herbal Tease
promos.hook: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana whispers, “Perhaps I was wrong,” hinting at a deeper shift in her worldview.
promos.why: A playful jab turns into a subtle character revelation, enticing viewers who love quiet tension and romance.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: It has advantages.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Very well.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: We'll see.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My mother wrote the same thing.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: And the scars... were they from the war?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Some were.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It must have been terrible.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: It was.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Perhaps I was wrong.
Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

promos.title: Ep46_ThePaperDuchess
promos.hook: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
promos.cliffhanger: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
promos.why: The High Priest’s cold legal threat shatters the romance in seconds, then promises a devastating reversal that leaves the Duke’s fate hanging.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: A church called me unworthy.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: A church chained me.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

promos.title: Mother Prisoner Vow
promos.hook: A scarred informant bows and whispers, “Your Grace.”
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander vows, “Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.”
promos.why: Shows the hero learning his mother is captive and his fierce promise of revenge, instantly gripping a new viewer.

script.text: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: Your Grace.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: And when we have the proof?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

promos.hook: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.
promos.cliffhanger: The heavy mahogany doors burst open, revealing Lady Catherine and a guard ready to accuse Juliana.
promos.why: A tender confession is shattered by a sudden, violent intrusion, leaving the viewer hanging on Juliana’s fate.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: He is no commoner. What does he do?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: My lost son wore that ring!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: What is your husband's name?
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.

promos.title: Thorny Cruelty
promos.hook: Look at her hands.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana screams “Ahhh!” as the thorns keep ripping her flesh.
promos.why: Shows the brutal torture and the sadistic taunt, instantly pulling viewers into Juliana’s desperate fight for survival.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: Look at her hands.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.
Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.
Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Please... enough!
Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Ah!
Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Stop!
Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Ahhh!

promos.title: Duke_Ep6_Quiet
promos.hook: JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful): "It is quiet."
promos.cliffhanger: JULIANA (V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised): "And yet..."
promos.why: A calm moment after turmoil hints at hope, then a trailing thought leaves the audience wondering what comes next.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It is quiet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Very quiet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I think I like that.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You are not disappointed?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I am.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But not because of you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You don't have to do that tonight.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.
Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: There.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: It is not much.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It is enough for tonight.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I lost my home today.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My family.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Everything I thought my life would be.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: And yet...

promos.hook: Who did this?
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?
promos.why: A brutal accusation followed by a desperate question pulls viewers into the mystery of Juliana's secret and Alexander's fury.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who did this?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It does not matter.
Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Lady Catherine.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Where did you meet her?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: What were you doing there?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?

promos.title: Ep47_ScrubOrDie
promos.hook: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!
promos.cliffhanger: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.
promos.why: A brutal command to exile a rival is instantly followed by a cruel bargain that forces the enemy into servitude, ending on a tense “or else” promise.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Stop.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: She did.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You want me? As a guest?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: As a scullery maid.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.

promos.title: 43_TreasonReveal
promos.hook: You're lying!
promos.cliffhanger: Rupert staggers backward as the damning Crown documents expose his treason, leaving his fate hanging.
promos.why: Shows a frantic accusation, a guard’s defiant salute, and a shocking betrayal that a new viewer can grasp instantly.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You're lying!
Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: I said arrest him!
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: We will not.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Your Duke!
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: No. He is your Duke.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You have all been deceived!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Read the first.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.

promos.title: E28_AccusationHook
promos.hook: Look at her, Rupert.
promos.cliffhanger: The dying Duchess gasps, “And you… you knew!” – the camera cuts before anyone can answer.
promos.why: The cruel mockery instantly shows Catherine’s power, then the Duchess’s desperate accusation raises the stakes of Juliana’s innocence and her mother’s life.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Look at her, Rupert.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Soot on her face...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: ...herbs in her pockets...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: ...a secret medicine in her hand.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: She looks exactly like a poisoner.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: A clever story, girl.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Rupert...

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Stop this!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: She is innocent.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: She saved me!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Your Grace...

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: I know what happened to me!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: I was poisoned!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: And you... you knew!

promos.title: Ep37_BetrayalReveal
promos.hook: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.
promos.cliffhanger: And after the ceremony…
promos.why: The line shatters the fragile hope of a wedding, instantly pulling a cold viewer into the cruel stakes, and ends on a tantalizing promise that leaves the horror hanging.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Send the invitations.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.

script.speaker: BUTLER
script.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: Catherine's wedding.

script.speaker: NOBLEMAN
script.text: So it is finally official.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: And after the ceremony...

promos.title: Harringtons' Curse
promos.hook: She won't be seeing anything for long.
promos.cliffhanger: And its witch will be dead.
promos.why: The Harringtons openly declare Juliana's fate, then end on a deadly threat that leaves a cold‑viewer desperate to know if she survives.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: Good.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.
Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: We have an excellent view.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: Of the wedding?

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: And everything that comes after it.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Everything must go perfectly.
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: All entrances are covered?

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: Every one, my Lord.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Good.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: And its witch will be dead.

promos.title: Conspiracy Whisper
promos.hook: "Sterling... and Rupert." – Alexander names the conspirators behind his disappearance.
promos.cliffhanger: "And when you disappeared...?" – the lingering question that demands an answer.
promos.why: Introduces the betrayal by trusted allies and ends on an unanswered question, compelling the audience to learn the full plot.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Sterling... and Rupert.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Rupert?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: They knew where I was.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: They gave you to the enemy?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: They gave them my location.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: They wanted the investigation buried.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: And when you disappeared...?

promos.title: Rupert's Dark Plot
promos.hook: Rupert whispers, “Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown… the title is mine.”
promos.cliffhanger: He threatens, “They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.”
promos.why: A chilling conspiracy is revealed in a single breath, leaving the audience hungry for the power struggle.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: ...the title is mine.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: They disgust me.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.
